result.description: Hyve Managed Hosting Pty Ltd  The Technical Support Engineer is responsible for the deployment, administration and ongoing support of Hyve's managed hosting and private-cloud infrastructure for its Australian customers. The role ensures the availability, performance, security and integrity of business-critical server, virtualisation, network and storage platforms, and provides expert technical support as Hyve establishes and grows its Australian operations.   Benefits  You'll work closely with customers and collaborate with experienced engineers across Australia and the UK, sharing knowledge and helping deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes for our global customer base. If you enjoy solving problems, taking ownership, and continuously developing your technical skills, we'd love to hear from you.   Task & responsibilities  •  Installing, configuring and maintaining Linux and Windows server operating systems across managed hosting and private-cloud environments.  •  Administering and maintaining virtualisation and container platforms, including VMware and OpenShift, to ensure availability and performance.  •  Deploying, managing and maintaining physical and virtual server infrastructure for enterprise customer environments.  •  Monitoring system and platform performance, capacity and integrity, and proactively resolving faults to meet agreed service levels.  •  Administering web, application and database platforms, including IIS, Apache, MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server.  •  Configuring and maintaining Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange and related identity and messaging services.  •  Configuring and maintaining load balancers, firewalls and web application security technologies to protect customer environments.  •  Diagnosing and resolving network and connectivity issues, including TCP/IP, DNS and routing.  •  Administering enterprise storage and compute resources, and managing backups, patching and system hardening.  •  Performing root-cause analysis on incidents, documenting resolutions and contributing to post-incident reviews.  •  Maintaining system documentation, knowledge-base articles and operational procedures.  •  Participating in an on-call, out-of-hours support roster to maintain platform availability.   Qualification & experience  •  A relevant tertiary qualification in information technology or computer science, or equivalent demonstrated experience.  •  At least five years' experience administering Linux and Windows server environments in production.  •  Demonstrated experience with virtualisation (VMware, OpenShift/Kubernetes), enterprise networking, storage and security technologies.  •  Strong troubleshooting, incident-management and customer-service skills.  •  Willingness to participate in an on-call / out-of-hours support roster.  About Company     Hyve is expanding into Australia, and we're looking to build a team of Technical Support Engineers to be among the first key hires in our Sydney office.    This is a rare opportunity to join an established UK managed hosting provider at the ground level of its Australian growth. You'll play a key role in supporting customer environments, helping shape our local operations, and delivering the exceptional level of service that Hyve is known for.    We provide enterprise-grade managed hosting, private cloud, and infrastructure solutions for organisations that value uptime, security, performance, and expert support. Our customers rely on us to manage business-critical environments, and we pride ourselves on delivering a level of service that goes above and beyond what is typically found in the industry. Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

result.description: Greenultimate Pty Ltd   The ICT Support Engineer  will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT systems and infrastructure to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role involves troubleshooting hardware, software and network issues, installing and maintaining computer systems, providing technical support to staff, monitoring system performance, and assisting with system improvements. The successful candidate will also maintain technical documentation, deliver user guidance, and work closely with internal teams to ensure reliable, secure and efficient ICT services.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Lead and drive IT systems and infrastructure efficiency in the organisation.  Conduct regular system reviews and quality audits to evaluate the performance, reliability and security of ICT systems.  Analyse system performance, identify risks, gaps or areas of non-compliance, and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency and service quality.  Monitor ICT systems, processes and documentation to ensure compliance with company standards and operational procedures.  Investigate, evaluate and diagnose hardware, software, LAN, WAN, network and connectivity issues in company offices, and provide timely support with resolutions.  Install, configure, maintain, upgrade and troubleshoot computers, operating systems, software applications, printers, networks and cloud-based services.  Develop and deliver technical guidance and user training on software applications, business systems and ICT procedures.  Work closely with staff and management to promote awareness of ICT policies, security practices and quality standards.  Create, review and maintain technical documentation, including user guides, operating procedures, technical specifications and support records.  Provide technical expertise to support system maintenance, infrastructure improvements and the ongoing reliability of business systems.  Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues and improve system performance and customer service.    Qualification & experience      A relevant bachelor’s degree qualification is highly preferred  Minimum 2 years of work experience in a similar role  Excellent troubleshooting and Problem-solving skills  Strong Communication and time management abilities  Support team culture and work collaboratively with colleagues  Strong customer service skills with a proactive and professional approach. result.description:
Gorski Engineering


Position  : Full Time
Location : Somerton, VIC
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year


Established in 1975, proudly Australian, family-owned and operated company, Gorski Engineering is Australia’s leading manufacturer of Premium Tipping Trailers and Tipping Truck Bodies. Experts in both Hardox and Aluminium. 

Gorski Engineering is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Welder to join their team.

Duties and Responsibilities:
Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and standards to establish the job requirements
Plan the work sequence accordingly
Select and prepare metal stock
Carry out trial fits for mechanical/structural assemblies
Weld, fabricate and assemble steel works, pipe works and other mechanical/structural works
Finish product by cleaning, polishing, filing or bathing in acid solutions, or by applying protective or decorative coatings
Exam, use and maintain tools and equipment safely

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
Relevant Trade Qualification
At least 2 years relevant experience 
Ability to work in a team environment 
Work Health Safety (WHS) knowledge


If you think you’ve got the skills and experience to join the team, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Operating since 1982, Werner Engineering has an unparalleled reputation as the one stop engineering workshop of choice. They use the latest technology to offer fast, accurate and high quality workmanship to minimise down time and increase productivity and efficiency for their clients.

Werner Engineering is locally owned Mackay-based machining and fabrication workshop, specialising the manufacture and repair of parts for the mining, transport, sugar, agricultural and local industries

Werner Engineering is looking for CNC/METAL MACHINISTS to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

To be considered for the role you will possess the following skills, experience, and attributes:
Able to interpret technical/engineering drawings and verbal and written instructions.
Set up and operate a variety of machine tools to produce precision parts and instruments. Includes precision instrument makers who fabricate, modify, or repair mechanical instruments.
Use handheld tools and power tools to make and repair parts and products.
Identify any defective items and handle accordingly to established procedures.
Service and maintain the equipment in the machine shop to a high standard, including regular pre-start inspections and housekeeping.
Machine pins, spacers, bushes, hydraulic rams to repair.
Strip and repair a hydraulic cylinder, including machining new components to replace damaged parts.
Fabricate special tools to assist in the repair of plant and machinery.
Apply knowledge of mechanics, shop mathematics, metal properties, layout, and machining procedures.
Perform routine and corrective maintenance, machining & project work in a heavy engineering or mining environment in a safe, legal and effective manner
Strong problem-solving skills
Positive, solution focused attitude.
Ensure that all work is carried out in a safe and efficient manner.
Ability to carry out work with minimal supervision (ability to work autonomously beneficial)
Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with team members.

If you possess the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
